candidates.change_summary: Replace owner assignment to set owner to tx.origin instead of msg.sender in owned(), causing owner to differ when called via a contract.
Replace owner assignment to set owner to address(0) instead of msg.sender in owned(), clearing owner.
Replace owner assignment to set owner to the zero-extended value of msg.sender shifted, producing a different address (non-equivalent assignment).
Invert onlyOwner modifier requirement so it requires caller NOT to be owner, allowing non-owners to call owned() and thus change owner.
